about_short_description.short_description: Jordan Ahli Bank offers banking and financial service as well as committed to developing and empowering its staff.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Banking accounts for individuals, including current, salary transfer, savings, and fixed deposit accounts for everyday transactions and saving funds.

product.name: Personal Loans
product.description: Consumer financing for individuals to fund personal needs, with specialized programs available for selected professions and customer groups.

product.name: Credit, Debit and Prepaid Cards
product.description: Payment cards for purchases, cash access, online transactions, and controlled prepaid spending, with support for contactless and digital-wallet payments.

product.name: Housing Loans
product.description: Mortgage and housing finance for eligible customers purchasing or financing residential property.

product.name: Auto Loans (Finance & Go)
product.description: Vehicle financing for individuals purchasing a car, with repayment structured according to the approved financing terms.

product.name: Digital Banking and Payments
product.description: Digital banking services for account access, transfers, bill payments, and mobile transactions through ahli Mobile and supported payment networks.
